name: project
description: All packages (per-repo) for one project name (e.g. "firefox").

name: problems
description: Outstanding maintenance problems for a project.

name: repositories
description: List all package repositories indexed by Repology (distros, BSDs, language ecosystems, etc.) with their names, family, and active/total package counts.

name: maintainer
description: Maintainer summary by canonical maintainer id (often email).

name: projects_search
description: Paginate or filter Repology projects by name substring, maintainer, category, or repository membership; returns up to 200 project names per page with their per-repo version data.

start_name.description: Pagination cursor — project name to start at.

end_name.description: Pagination cursor — project name to end at (reverse).
